games.title: A Way Through
games.description: You pilot a light hydrofoil skiff across a drowned limestone valley. You can skim, bank, drift, hop, and catch the lift off a floating launch. Your skiff carries a small current-making mechanism: while tethered to a boat's harbour bell, water you actually cross becomes a persistent directed flow. Boats use that flow with their own hulls, turning limits, and clearance requirements. They bring people and equipment into places you connect. Their arrivals open new physical passages and movement opportunities. The last crossing uses the network you made.

games.title: ARC
games.description: There's no road until you throw one. You carry a swift whose tail is made of light: throw it and the tail hangs in the air as a rail. Ride the rail. It ends in mid-air over black water, so call the swift back — it eats the road on the way — and catching it at speed throws you into the next throw. Three big slow animals in the way, and a dam at the end.
controls: Hold left mouse to throw, longer for further · skate onto the tail to ride · right mouse to call it back · WASD skate, lean, tuck, drag a foot · Space hop or pop off · M mute · Esc pause

games.title: IN EVERY DIRECTION
games.description: First person. An autumn forest that goes on forever in every direction, with crunching leaves, piles of leaves and falling leaves. A swing in a huge old tree, a cabin with smoke coming out of the chimney, a bench someone put where the view is, and so many more that it’s impossible to find them all. Walk north and it slowly turns to winter, west into spring, south into summer, and you can get lost in any of them forever. The sun rises in the east and sets in the west, and at night the sky is filled with stars and different animals come out. You can hunt animals with a rifle and catch fish with a fishing rod. No HUD. Keyboard and mouse, or two thumbs on a phone.
genres: Endless walk through all four seasons
